name: Budibase
tagline: Open source low-code platform. Build internal tools in hours.
shortDescription: Self-hostable low-code platform for building internal tools, admin panels, and forms. Connects to SQL/NoSQL/APIs. The Retool alternative you can self-host.
longDescription:
## What it is

Budibase is a low-code platform designed for internal tools. Self-hostable, supports SQL (Postgres, MySQL, MS SQL, Oracle), MongoDB, REST, Google Sheets, and more. The visual builder outputs production-ready apps with auth, automations, and RBAC.

## Why we recommend it

If you want the speed of Retool without the per-user fees and without the cloud-only constraint, Budibase is the answer. Connect to your existing DB, build CRUD screens, and ship.

## When to use it

- Admin panels over an existing Postgres database
- Internal CRUD apps that would take weeks to build from scratch
- Approval workflows and forms
- Replacing spreadsheets with proper apps
installInstructions:
**Docker (self-host):**
```
docker run -d -p 80:80 -v budibase_data:/data budibase/budibase:latest
```

**Cloud:** Free tier with 5 users, 1 app, 1K rows.
pricingDetails: Self-host: free. Cloud: free tier (5 users). Premium from $50/month per app builder.
